title: The Debate Over Resilience
text:
Resilience has emerged as a central concept in ecological research. In its simplest sense, it describes the capacity of a system to absorb disturbance and reorganise without losing its essential function. Researchers have increasingly applied the notion to cities, economies and social networks.

Yet the concept remains contested. Critics argue that the emphasis on recovery can obscure the underlying vulnerabilities that make communities susceptible to shocks in the first place. Consequently, some scholars advocate a transformative approach that questions whether the existing order should be restored at all.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does resilience describe?
options: The capacity of a system to absorb disturbance and reorganise
The speed at which cities are rebuilt
The total cost of ecological damage
The number of species in a region

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do critics argue about the emphasis on recovery?
options: It is supported by most economists

questions.text: What can be inferred about the transformative approach?
options: It may regard restoring the existing order as insufficient
It focuses only on economic growth
It has already been widely adopted by cities

questions.text: The author's attitude toward the concept of resilience is best described as:
options: Balanced, acknowledging both its use and its debate

vocabulary.definition: the ability of a system to recover from difficulty
an event that interrupts the normal state of something
weak points that make something easy to harm
causing a major and fundamental change

paragraph_translations: Dayanıklılık, ekolojik araştırmalarda merkezi bir kavram olarak öne çıkmıştır. En basit anlamıyla, bir sistemin bozulmalara direnme ve temel işlevini kaybetmeden yeniden düzenlenme kapasitesini tanımlar. Araştırmacılar bu kavramı giderek daha fazla şehirlere, ekonomilere ve sosyal ağlara uygulamaktadır.

Ancak kavram hâlâ tartışmalıdır. Eleştirmenler, iyileşmeye yapılan vurgunun, toplulukları şoklara karşı savunmasız kılan altta yatan kırılganlıkları gizleyebileceğini savunmaktadır. Bu nedenle bazı akademisyenler, mevcut düzenin geri getirilip getirilmemesi gerektiğini sorgulayan dönüştürücü bir yaklaşımı savunmaktadır.
